body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Psychic, Arcane, Radiant or Necrotic Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn; its space sheds ordinary light during that time.

surges.html: It gains +1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.
Suppress one ordinary magical distraction penalty on it until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Ward
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind the target. Trigger: a detected enemy within 3 units uses an Action imposing a mental Condition on it. Echo: grant +1 Composure against that Action before its roll.
